references.title: The Model Confidence Set
references.scope: Standard temporal-loss MCS; the nonlinear crossed-seed functional used here is an extension, not covered merely by its name. Fixed bootstrap scales are part of standard MCS construction and not alone a coding error.

references.title: Bootstrapping data arrays of arbitrary order
references.scope: Product reweighting for crossed arrays; sufficient assumptions for variance of a mean do not provide a universal finite-sample theorem for full-functional RMSE, studentization or a temporally dependent bootstrap.
